d: Long, flowing jet black hair is styled with choppy bangs and a high ponytail. The eyes are a vibrant electric blue with a sharp, focused expression on a face with the apparent age and maturity of a teenager. The build is slender, dressed in a form-fitting black tactical suit with mint green accents and silver metallic plating on the collar and shoulders. The right hand is encased in a mint green and black armored glove, gripping a large mechanical black and silver blade.
